answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) possess an extraordinary ability to understand and generate natural language.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs updated knowledge in response to questions, such as changing the answer to 'Who is the President of the US?' from 'Donald Trump' to 'Joe Biden'.

answer_2.quote: The quality of knowledge updating has the following three evaluation indicators: (1) Reliability ... (2) Generalization ... (3) Locality ...
